title: Farhampton
cn: 第 1 集 · 法汉普顿
novel: Robin felt [[anxious|anxious]] on her wedding day. She sat alone in a room and tried to [[calm|calm]] her nerves. She wondered if she was making the right decision. Ted came to check on her and tried to [[reassure|reassure]] her. He told her that Barney loved her and that everything would be fine. Robin [[appreciated|appreciate]] Ted's words but still felt [[uneasy|uneasy]]. Meanwhile, Ted recounted the story of leaving Victoria's fiancé a note. He had driven off with Victoria after she left her fiancé at the altar. Ted felt [[guilty|guilty]] about it but believed it was the right thing to do. He had written a note explaining everything and left it at the fiancé's door. The fiancé had called Ted and was furious. Ted tried to [[apologize|apologize]] but the man would not listen. Ted [[realized|realize]] that his actions had consequences. He wondered if he was making the same mistake Barney was about to make. Barney, meanwhile, was [[confident|confident]] about the wedding. He dressed in his best suit and [[practiced|practice]] his vows. He told Ted he had never been more sure of anything in his life. Robin finally took a deep breath and decided to go through with the wedding. She told herself that Barney was the one she wanted to spend her life with. The gang [[gathered|gather]] together, ready for the big day.

reassure.en: to make someone feel less worried

guilty.en: feeling bad about something you did
